decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric program remains highly central to the firm's mental health services and has a dedicated page, so accumulated investment and public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.

Although less central than core care services, the carpentry workshop has a dedicated page and builds on established production know-how, so the firm is likely to justify its visible investment by continuing.

Outpatient sociotherapy has lower website visibility but is close to the firm's core mental health and support services, so the firm will likely persist while attributing any disappointing outcomes to temporary causes.
Because it is shown on the home page and directly serves the firm's eldercare mission, public commitment and high centrality make dropping very unlikely.
As a newer everyday-life service with only a website mention, meal delivery has less accumulated investment but still fits the firm's announced direction, so management will likely give it more time.
